node.title: Possible to change package of code reference?
node.author: nysus
node.doctext:
I have the following to output the contents of a $func which contains a code reference: my $deparse = B::Deparse->new; print dumper $deparse->coderef2text($func);

It spits out:

$VAR1 = '{ package Spin::Command::spin; run(q[export MYVAR=\'(R)?ex\']); run(\'uname -a\'); run(q[echo \'Running: \' $MYVAR]); run(\'id\'); }';

I'd like to change the package from Spin::Command::spin to something else. Is this possible?

$PM = "Perl Monk's";
$MCF = "Most Clueless Friar Abbot Bishop Pontiff Deacon Curate Priest Vicar";
$nysus = $PM . ' ' . $MCF;
